description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Requirement Your Resonance is 8 or lower.

While below Legion Resonance, spend a full Cut to suppress your own Resonance band's effects for a day.

You perform a full Cut on your own grafted tissue, quieting it rather than removing it. For the next 24 hours, treat your Resonance as one band lower for the purpose of its effects. Your actual Resonance total is unchanged, and this cannot be used to suppress Chorus (9) or Legion (10) — only to soften Humming or Loud.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, treating own Resonance as one band lower for 24h has nothing to modify.
